xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex502-19072023-05-24" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs>'i zhal nas |<quote> <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> <pb n="5a"/><lb n="5a1"/> dngos bzhugs tsam na bla ma dkon mchog bzhi pa yin | sangs rgyas 'das nas 'khor dag yod tsam na bla ma de sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa yin | da lta sangs rgyas las lhag pa yin gsung ste | de la rgyu mtshan gsum sangs rgyas thams cad <lb n="5a2"/> kyi 'phrin las bsdus pa yin pas na bla ma de sangs rgyas las lhag | snyigs ma lnga'i dus su skyob pas bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag | byang chub kyi lam dngos su ston pas bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag go | de ltar yin pa yang | tshogs chen po yis <lb n="5a3"/> lung ston dpal la phyag 'tshal lo || sems can nyam thag gnas nas 'don la || dngos su ston cing dri ma bral la bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo ||</quote> zhes <expan>gsungs so</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
